record.body:
## Rationale

User chose full + advisory for this repository. Keep running the README full suite at phase head and recording a check-run, but do not block Landing on fail. Failures remain visible (check-run + finding / dashboard) without burning retry loops that block merge for flakes.

## Counter-argument

full+required preserves the strongest local safety net before merge. smoke+required would keep a hard gate cheap. Both still cost either time or coverage; advisory explicitly trades blocking for throughput given known flake and duration pain.

payload.choice: this repo: suite mode=full, gate=advisory, README full command
